issue-4192: Export button stays greyed out after a failed export
Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Reset export button state after a failed export
args.body: File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx. In handleClick, the call to exportReport only has a .then() handler that clears busy and shows a success toast; if the returned promise rejects (e.g. a non-2xx response throws in exportReport), setBusy(false) is never called, so the button stays disabled until the page is reloaded. Add a .catch() (or use try/catch with async/await) that resets busy to false and shows an error toast when the export fails.
